_README: Provenance of the Essence Crafting recipe table. Pinned point-in-time snapshot of veteran-software/yourddo, adopted 2026-09-20 as the SOURCE OF TRUTH for Essence Crafting placements, enchantments and bonus types — by owner decision, replacing the ddowiki `table 1b`/`table 3b` harvest which carried ~40% of the table (#837).
_vendoring: Fetched PINNED TO THE SHA above, never from HEAD: curl -sSfL -o data/seed/compendium/raw/yourddo_essence_recipes.json https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veteran-software/yourddo/25c90c65b671eb3d8333e689526230142c35b527/src/data/essenceCrafting.v2.json
_second_hand: Their own commit for this file adds a 'Dungeon Helper' attribution link to the Essence Crafting page, so this table may itself be derived rather than first-party. Recorded because provenance that stops one hop short is provenance that looks firmer than it is. Not a reason to distrust it — 82 of 87 magnitudes it shares with our independent ddowiki harvest agree exactly — but the chain is two links, not one.
_known_upstream_defects: `Ranged Alacrity` grants the enchantment `Melee Attack Speed`, untyped, while `Melee Alacrity` grants the same enchantment typed Enhancement.

Slot vocabulary carries 25 names for ~14 real slots, mixing an anatomical set (Neck, Head, Eyes, Wrists, Waist, Feet, Hands, Rings) with an item set (Necklace, Headgear, Goggles, Bracers, Belt, Boots, Gloves, Ring). `Fingers` and `Hand` each appear once and are singular slips of `Rings` and `Hands`.
Dice magnitudes are stored as the die COUNT only: `Bashing` reads 6 where the wiki publishes 6d6. Our ddowiki values are richer for the three dice effects.
_disagreements_with_our_wiki_harvest: Measured at ML30 across every effect both sources carry: 82 agree exactly, 5 differ. Three are the dice-count loss above. Two are `Diversion`/`Insightful Diversion`, which they store NEGATIVE (-21, -10) as threat reduction where our harvest read the magnitude unsigned.
